blocks.text: -CN functional group wale organic compounds alkanenitriles hain, maslan ethanenitrile CH3CN aur propanenitrile CH3CH2CN. Halogenoalkanes aur KCN se in ki tayyari Chapter 21 mein di gayi. Nitriles ka sab se ahem istemal in ki hydrolysis se carboxylic acids banana hai, jo halke tezaab ya halki alkali se ho sakti hai.

items: Tezaabi hydrolysis: halke hydrochloric ya sulphuric acid ke saath garam karne se carboxylic acid banta hai: CH3CN(aq) + 2H2O(l) + HCl(aq) -> CH3COOH(aq) + NH4Cl(aq).

Alkaline hydrolysis: halke sodium hydroxide ke saath garam karne se tezaab ka namak aur ammonia bante hain, CH3CN(aq) + H2O(l) + NaOH(aq) -> CH3COONa(aq) + NH3(g); halke HCl se tezaabi karne par tezaab azad hota hai: CH3COONa(aq) + HCl(aq) -> CH3COOH(aq) + NaCl(aq).

blocks.prompt: Propanenitrile ko halke sodium hydroxide ke saath garam karne par kaun si gas nikalti hai, aur organic product kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia; sodium propanoate, CH3CH2COONa (jo tezaabi karne par propanoic acid deta hai).

items: Tezaabi hydrolysis: RCOOH + NH4Cl; alkaline: RCOONa + NH3, phir tezaab.
